production_ready_basis: Automated release gates passed. Ready to publish as the requested tester build; human gameplay, audio and hardware acceptance remain open.
release_scope: Hero ship: continuous closed airframe, fitted canopy/wings/engines and corrected Classic silhouette depth ordering.
Model catalogue: nine enemy types, Sentinel shutters and details, pickup badges, missiles and scenery; repaired inward tapered-box face winding.
Atmosphere: procedural planet/rings, quieter nebulae, detailed city and skyline, refined asteroids, smoke, dust and grain.
Combat feedback: damage/weak-point/kill/armor confirmations and actionable boss status. Armor ricochets no longer inflate successful-hit counts.
Audio: distinct damage confirmations, shorter/softer laser transient and a duckable weapon bus giving pilot warnings space.
Repository: remove generated screenshots and rendered audio; retain historical text evidence, current JSON validation and all source/test generators.
constraints: Preserve the eight-sector campaign and accepted Classic, Modern and Chase camera rigs.
Preserve the gentle opening, level forward fire, Flight Assist opt-in, hit volumes, HP, enemy timings and seeded fortress rules.
Keep handoff in JSON. All game visuals/audio remain procedurally generated.
remaining_acceptance: Human full-campaign playtest of opening pace, fuel, gates, boss vulnerabilities and Loop 2.
Speakers/headphones audition of damage versus armor, warning priority, dense-combat mix and stereo placement.
Physical controller and phone/tablet portrait/landscape play.
Sustained hardware frame pacing and resource stability through repeated restarts.
evidence_policy: Keep new generated screenshots and WAVs in ignored artifacts/ only while reviewing. Current evidence is consolidated in docs/release-validation.json. Historical text/JSON reports remain; their removed tracked images are recoverable in Git history, or regenerated with QA scripts.
